mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TRIAL_PARTICIPATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRIAL_PARTICIPATION ( PARTICIPATION_NO, MEMBER_NO, TRIAL_NO, BUSINESS_NO, STATUS, APPLIED_AT, APPROVED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT ) VALUES ( #{participationNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memberNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trialNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{businessNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'APPLIED', SYSDATE, NULL, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PARTICIPATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.STATUS, P.APPLIED_AT, P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, B.ORG_NAME AS BUSINESS_ORG_NAME FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND P.TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo}

SELECT P.PARTICIPATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.STATUS, P.APPLIED_AT, P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, B.ORG_NAME AS BUSINESS_ORG_NAME FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND P.PARTICIPATION_NO = #{participationNo}

SELECT P.PARTICIPATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.STATUS, P.APPLIED_AT, P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, B.ORG_NAME AS BUSINESS_ORG_NAME FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY P.APPLIED_AT DESC, P.PARTICIPATION_NO DESC

SELECT P.PARTICIPATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.STATUS, P.APPLIED_AT, P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL, B.ORG_NAME AS BUSINESS_ORG_NAME FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND P.PARTICIPATION_NO = #{participationNo}

SELECT P.PARTICIPATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.TRIAL_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.STATUS, P.APPLIED_AT, P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, T.TITLE AS TRIAL_TITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL, B.ORG_NAME AS BUSINESS_ORG_NAME FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} ORDER BY CASE P.STATUS WHEN 'APPLIED' THEN 0 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 1 WHEN 'PARTICIPATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 3 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, P.APPLIED_AT DESC, P.PARTICIPATION_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIAL_PARTICIPATION SET BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}, STATUS = 'APPLIED', APPLIED_AT = SYSDATE, APPROVED_AT = NULL, STARTED_AT = NULL, COMPLETED_AT = NULL WHERE PARTICIPATION_NO = #{participationNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN')
